system.description:
By blending into cover, blurring your lines and moving carefully, you can evade notice or slip past people, taking advantage of light, shadow, timing and diversion.

With an appropriate Physical Challenge you can sneak past guards and searchers, who contest your Ability with their Mental Traits and Investigation. Stealth also augments the Obfuscate Discipline.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
